answer: When an agent first joins the network it deposits a small jade‑valued stake that is locked in a smart contract linked to a mutable reputation ledger. Each epoch the ledger updates the agent’s score by adding a delta proportional to verified work and by subtracting a shale‑scaled decay for inactivity, so long‑standing honest agents accumulate high reputation cheaply while newcomers start at zero. An attacker must simultaneously fund dozens of fresh stakes and keep each fake identity constantly active to offset the decay, raising the cost roughly linearly with the desired sybil count.
